metadata.description: Brand-agnostic AI skills for brand setup, research and Shopify content, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: blog-generator
plugins.description: Research and write SEO/AEO-optimized Shopify blog posts.

plugins.name: blog-rewriter
plugins.description: Rewrite existing articles in a store's brand voice and post as hidden drafts.

plugins.name: shopify-blog-autopilot
plugins.description: Decide when and what to blog from store, SEO and seasonal signals.

plugins.name: brand-capture
plugins.description: One-time brand setup: scans a site and writes BRAND.md, BRAND-VOICE.md and BRAND-QUESTIONS.md that every other skill reads.

plugins.name: styles-builder
plugins.description: Generate design.md from a brand book or reference store, apply it and the starter setup (logo, favicon, motion, inputs, variant pickers) into the theme's settings, and optionally brand the starter section templates.

plugins.name: competitor-research
plugins.description: Deep, dated research on a client's named competitors, written to COMPETITORS.md.

plugins.name: content-fact-check
plugins.description: Fact-check blog and marketing copy with guardrails for regulated claims.

plugins.name: accessibility-audit
plugins.description: Lighthouse accessibility scoring for Shopify themes with additive fixes and re-scoring.

plugins.name: content-seo-audit
plugins.description: Audit live Shopify blog posts (schema, PageSpeed, on-page checks) and track Search Console rankings at 2 and 4 weeks.

plugins.name: cro-review-mining
plugins.description: Mine a store's existing product reviews into pain-point/praise categories, root-cause/impact/metric tables, and A/B test ideas, written to REVIEW-MINING.md.

plugins.name: page-content-studio
plugins.description: Page work in focused skills: audit (read-only), create (new pages and sections), edit content (words, images, links) and edit design (layout, order, style), each verifying and pushing only to a draft theme.

plugins.name: analytics
plugins.description: Analytics partner: tagging and full audits across privacy states, setup from issue list to verified fixes, quick and zero-based tag cleanup, and guardrails with drift watch.
